accepted.s: Which one of the following was a sub-group of Chief Ministers constituted by NITI Aayog in 2015?
accepted.x: Rationalisation of Centrally Sponsored Schemes was one of the three 2015 sub-groups of Chief Ministers constituted by NITI Aayog.
accepted.tq: Use the exact subject list and distinguish the 2015 sub-groups from the later digital-payments committee.
accepted.sec: NITI Aayog sub-groups of Chief Ministers - subjects

accepted.s: Who was the convener of the NITI Aayog sub-group of Chief Ministers on Rationalisation of Centrally Sponsored Schemes?
accepted.x: The sub-group on Rationalisation of Centrally Sponsored Schemes was convened by Shivraj Singh Chouhan, then Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Match the subject with the correct Chief Minister rather than relying on the State association alone.
accepted.sec: NITI Aayog sub-groups of Chief Ministers - subjects

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
a. Rationalisation of Centrally Sponsored Schemes — Shivraj Singh Chouhan
b. Skill Development — Parkash Singh Badal
c. Swachh Bharat Abhiyan — N. Chandrababu Naidu
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All three pairs are correctly matched. Shivraj Singh Chouhan, Parkash Singh Badal and N. Chandrababu Naidu convened the respective sub-groups.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure subject–convener pairs and verify all three matches.
accepted.sec: NITI Aayog sub-groups of Chief Ministers - subjects

accepted.s:
With reference to the separate committee of Chief Ministers on digital payments, consider the following statements:
1. It was set up in 2016.
2. It was convened by N. Chandrababu Naidu.
3. It was one of the three NITI Aayog sub-groups constituted in 2015.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The digital-payments committee was set up in 2016 and was convened by N. Chandrababu Naidu. It was separate from the three 2015 sub-groups and therefore statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Separate the later committee from the original 2015 sub-groups and identify the false time-linked statement.
accepted.sec: NITI Aayog sub-groups of Chief Ministers - subjects

accepted.s: Regional Councils associated with NITI Aayog are primarily intended to deal with issues that
o: fall exclusively within the Union List
concern only Union Territories without legislatures
accepted.x: Regional Councils are convened for issues spanning or affecting more than one State.
accepted.tq: Identify the jurisdictional scope of the body before considering its composition.
accepted.sec: NITI Aayog sub-groups of Chief Ministers - subjects

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the leadership of a Regional Council associated with NITI Aayog?
o: It is headed by the Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog and the Chief Secretary of the concerned State.
It is jointly headed by a Chief Minister by rotation and a Union Minister.
It is headed exclusively by the Prime Minister.
It is jointly headed by the President and a Governor.
accepted.x: Each Regional Council is jointly headed by a Chief Minister on a rotational basis and a Union Minister.
accepted.tq: Apply the who-would-do-this-job method to distinguish joint leadership from exclusive leadership.
accepted.sec: NITI Aayog sub-groups of Chief Ministers - subjects

accepted.s: The description of NITI Aayog’s approach as “marble-cake federalism” refers primarily to
o: the working together of the Centre and States on a common platform through a bottom-up approach
the complete separation of Union and State functions
the financial control of States by the Union
the replacement of State governments by regional councils
accepted.x: NITI Aayog uses the expression “marble-cake federalism” for cooperative federalism, in which the Centre and States work together through a bottom-up approach.
accepted.tq: Translate the distinctive label into its underlying institutional meaning.
accepted.sec: NITI Aayog sub-groups of Chief Ministers - subjects

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Team India Hub — Building think-tank capacity
Knowledge and Innovation Hub — Leading the engagement of States with the Centre
Team India Hub — Leading the engagement of States with the Centre
Regional Council — Appointing the Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog
accepted.x: The Team India Hub leads the engagement of States with the Centre. The Knowledge and Innovation Hub builds think-tank capacity.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the two similarly named NITI Aayog hubs by their functions.
accepted.sec: NITI Aayog sub-groups of Chief Ministers - subjects

accepted.s: The Ease of Doing Business State Business Reform Action Plan is published by
accepted.x: The State Business Reform Action Plan rankings are associated with the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).
accepted.tq: Match the index with its exact publishing institution and avoid substituting NITI Aayog.
accepted.sec: State rankings - publisher and AP's rank

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. SDG India Index — NITI Aayog
2. Export Preparedness Index — NITI Aayog
3. State Health Index — NITI Aayog with MoHFW and World Bank
4. School Education Quality Index — NITI Aayog with MHRD
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched. The State Health Index involves NITI Aayog, MoHFW and the World Bank, while SEQI involves NITI Aayog and MHRD.
accepted.tq: Check each publisher–index pair independently, especially the collaborative publishers.
accepted.sec: State rankings - publisher and AP's rank

accepted.s: In the Export Preparedness Index 2024, released in January 2026, Andhra Pradesh was ranked
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh was ranked fifth among large States in the Export Preparedness Index 2024.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the specific index, edition and category before selecting the rank.
accepted.sec: State rankings - publisher and AP's rank

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes Andhra Pradesh’s position in the SDG India Index 2023–24?
o: It scored 100 out of 100 and was classified as a Front Runner State.
It ranked seventeenth and was classified as a Performer.
It scored 74 out of 100 and was classified as a Frontrunner.
It scored 57 out of 100 and was classified as an Aspirant.
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh scored 74 out of 100 in the SDG India Index 2023–24 and was classified as a “Frontrunner”.
accepted.tq: Read the score and category together; do not substitute a rank for a classification.
accepted.sec: State rankings - publisher and AP's rank

accepted.s:
With reference to Andhra Pradesh’s recent rankings and awards, consider the following statements:
1. Andhra Pradesh stood seventeenth in the Fiscal Health Index 2023–24.
2. Andhra Pradesh received five National Panchayat Awards in 2025.
3. Andhra Pradesh received more National Panchayat Awards than Karnataka in 2025.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh stood seventeenth in the Fiscal Health Index and received five National Panchayat Awards. Karnataka received six awards, so statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Use the numerical comparison to reject the reversed-ranking statement.
accepted.sec: State rankings - publisher and AP's rank

accepted.s: In the March 2026 rankings for the Basic Infrastructure theme of the ADP, which district of Andhra Pradesh ranked first in India?
accepted.x: Alluri Sitharama Raju district ranked first in India in the Basic Infrastructure theme of the ADP in the March 2026 rankings.
accepted.tq: Test the precise district–theme association rather than a general State ranking.
accepted.sec: State rankings - publisher and AP's rank

accepted.s: “Bargaining federalism” is associated with which scholar?
accepted.x: Morris-Jones described Indian federalism as “bargaining federalism”.
accepted.tq: Discriminate among scholars linked with different labels of Indian federalism.
accepted.sec: Federalism labels - scholar

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Federation with a strong centralising tendency — Ivor Jennings
accepted.x: “Bargaining federalism” is associated with Morris-Jones, not Granville Austin. The other three pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped scholar–label pair among closely related descriptions.
accepted.sec: Federalism labels - scholar

accepted.s: The Governing Council of NITI Aayog was first constituted in
accepted.x: The Governing Council of NITI Aayog was first constituted in February 2015 and was reconstituted in February 2021.
accepted.tq: Separate the first constitution from the later reconstitution date.
accepted.sec: Governing Council of NITI Aayog - members, meetings

accepted.s:
Which of the following are members of the Governing Council of NITI Aayog?
1. Prime Minister
2. Chief Ministers of all States
3. Chief Ministers of Union Territories having legislatures
4. Lieutenant Governors of other Union Territories
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The Governing Council includes the Prime Minister, all State Chief Ministers, Chief Ministers of UTs with legislatures, and Lieutenant Governors of other UTs.
accepted.tq: Check the composition category by category, including the distinction between UTs with and without legislatures.
accepted.sec: Governing Council of NITI Aayog - members, meetings

accepted.s: Which of the following is included in the Governing Council of NITI Aayog in addition to the Prime Minister, Chief Ministers and Lieutenant Governors?
o: Only Members of Parliament nominated by the Speaker
Only serving Governors of all States
The Chief Justice of India and all High Court Chief Justices
Ex-officio members, the Vice-Chairperson, full-time members and special invitees
accepted.x: The Governing Council also includes ex-officio members, the Vice-Chairperson, full-time members and special invitees.
accepted.tq: Use the composition list to reject institutions that are not part of the Council.
accepted.sec: Governing Council of NITI Aayog - members, meetings

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding meetings of the Governing Council of NITI Aayog:
1. It generally meets once a year.
2. Its meeting frequency is fixed by a statutory schedule.
3. Its eleventh meeting was held on 11 June 2026 at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Council generally meets once a year, but there is no statutory frequency. Its eleventh meeting was held on 11 June 2026 at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
accepted.tq: Separate customary practice from a legally fixed schedule and verify the dated event.
accepted.sec: Governing Council of NITI Aayog - members, meetings

accepted.s: Which one of the following was associated with the eleventh meeting of the Governing Council of NITI Aayog held on 11 June 2026?
o: The Prime Minister spoke on AI safeguards and El Nino, while N. Chandrababu Naidu presented Swarna Andhra @2047.
The meeting dealt exclusively with the reconstitution of the Finance Commission.
The Prime Minister presented Swarna Andhra @2047, while N. Chandrababu Naidu spoke on GST compensation.
The meeting was chaired by the Vice-Chairperson at NITI Aayog headquarters.
accepted.x: At the eleventh meeting, the Prime Minister spoke on AI safeguards, El Nino and cooperative federalism, while N. Chandrababu Naidu presented Swarna Andhra @2047.
accepted.tq: Use the event-specific details to distinguish the correct speaker–subject association.
accepted.sec: Governing Council of NITI Aayog - members, meetings

accepted.s: The Governing Council of NITI Aayog took over the role earlier associated with the
accepted.x: The Governing Council took over the role of the National Development Council, which is now inactive.
accepted.tq: Identify the predecessor body by function rather than by constitutional status.
accepted.sec: Governing Council of NITI Aayog - members, meetings

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the structure of NITI Aayog:
1. The Prime Minister is its Chairperson.
2. The Vice-Chairperson is appointed by the Prime Minister.
3. There can be a maximum of two part-time members on a rotational basis.
4. There can be a maximum of four ex-officio Union Ministers.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. NITI Aayog is chaired by the Prime Minister; its Vice-Chairperson is appointed by the Prime Minister, with up to two part-time and four ex-officio Union Minister members.
accepted.tq: Test institutional structure through a complete composition statement rather than one isolated designation.
accepted.sec: Governing Council of NITI Aayog - members, meetings

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly states the position of the Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog?
o: The CEO is always a Chief Minister nominated by the Prime Minister.
The CEO is elected by the Governing Council for an unlimited tenure.
The CEO is a Secretary-rank officer appointed for a fixed tenure.
The CEO is appointed by the Speaker of the Lok Sabha.
accepted.x: The Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog is a Secretary-rank officer with a fixed tenure.
accepted.tq: Apply the authority-and-office test to distinguish the administrative CEO from political members.
accepted.sec: Governing Council of NITI Aayog - members, meetings

accepted.s: Who became the Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog in April 2026, replacing Suman K. Bery?
accepted.x: Ashok Kumar Lahiri became Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog in April 2026, replacing Suman K. Bery.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the Vice-Chairperson from the listed full-time members through the appointment change.
accepted.sec: Governing Council of NITI Aayog - members, meetings

accepted.s: Article 279A of the Constitution relates to the
accepted.x: Article 279A provides for the Goods and Services Tax Council.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact constitutional Article associated with the fiscal institution.
accepted.sec: GST Council as a cooperative federalism model

accepted.s:
With reference to voting in the GST Council, consider the following statements:
1. The Centre has one-third of the weighted votes.
2. The States collectively have two-thirds of the weighted votes.
3. The voting structure reflects joint decision-making by the Centre and the States.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Centre has one-third and the States collectively have two-thirds of the votes in the GST Council, reflecting joint Centre–State decision-making.
accepted.tq: Check the numerical distribution and then connect it with the federal principle it represents.
accepted.sec: GST Council as a cooperative federalism model

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs correctly represents the usual relationship between the institution or mechanism and the type of federalism?
o: GST Council — Cooperative federalism; NITI Aayog rankings — Competitive federalism
GST Council — Competitive federalism; NITI Aayog rankings — Cooperative federalism
Both GST Council and NITI Aayog rankings — Competitive federalism
Both GST Council and NITI Aayog rankings — Cooperative federalism
accepted.x: The GST Council is generally cited as a model of cooperative federalism, whereas NITI Aayog rankings encourage competitive federalism.
accepted.tq: Use the contrast between joint decision-making and performance-based comparison.
accepted.sec: GST Council as a cooperative federalism model

accepted.s: Which of the following is identified as a criticism of the Goods and Services Tax from the States’ perspective?
o: It curtailed States’ taxation powers because many local taxes were subsumed and led to compensation disputes.
It made compensation disputes impossible by providing an unlimited statutory guarantee.
It expanded the independent taxation powers of States by adding several new local taxes.
It abolished all Union taxation powers and transferred them to local bodies.
accepted.x: The GST subsumed many local taxes, thereby curtailing several State taxation powers, and compensation disputes emerged between the Centre and States.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise criticism and reject statements that reverse the fiscal effect of GST.
accepted.sec: GST Council as a cooperative federalism model
